nodes.title: 节点7说明1

widgets_values:
COOKIE CLUB chocolate chip cookie brand product video, 20 seconds, 16:9. Y2K street youth aesthetic, colorful collage and sticker animation style.

[0-3s] Brand world: Reference <Picture 1>. Blue background, a chocolate chip cookie mascot wearing blue sunglasses and pink sneakers jumps into frame with star stickers flying around, energetic and dynamic movement.

[3-6s] Product unboxing: Reference <Picture 2>. Blue COOKIE CLUB packaging box front clearly displayed, pink "COOKIE CLUB" text and smiley logo absolutely readable, box slowly opens on blue-pink V-shaped collage background revealing chocolate chip cookies inside.

[6-10s] Appetite close-up: Reference <Picture 3>. Stacked bitten chocolate chip cookies, chocolate chips and crumbly interior texture clearly visible, appetizing, macro lens quality.

[10-12s] Lifestyle intro: Reference <Picture 4>. One boy and one girl together holding cookies, girl in blue sweater with silver necklace, boy in black Y2K hoodie, both holding chocolate chip cookies, standing naturally on blue-pink collage background, joyful and sweet expressions. Brand English "COOKIE CLUB" text clearly readable.

[12-14s] Interaction close-up: Reference image 4. The two people gently clink their cookies together like toasting, chocolate crumbles slightly splashing, then both take a bite at the same time, exchanging satisfied smiles. Close-up shot capturing the interaction moment, background remains blue-pink Y2K collage style.

[14-17s] Dynamic collage: Reference <Picture 5>. Cookies and chocolate chip fragments floating and scattering in the air on blue-pink circular collage background, with speed sensation and sticker animation style.

[17-20s] Final lock-up: Reference <Picture 6>. Blue COOKIE CLUB box centered with mascot printed on it, surrounded by stacked cookies, pink "COOKIE CLUB" text and smiley logo prominently clear, overall freeze frame in brand poster style.

Consistent blue and pink color scheme throughout, brand English text must remain absolutely clear and readable, unified sticker collage style. No gibberish or extra text.
